about: AVOS model catalog: which open model does which job, where it can run, and its licence. Used by the Facts pipeline (agentic_core), the Animations studio (animation_studio) and the Models page. Facts checked October 2026 against each model's own page and fal.ai's API docs; re-check licences before commercial use.

gpu.label: Your GPU workers (Model Fabric)
gpu.how: Run the AVOS GPU worker (apps/gpu_worker) on any NVIDIA GPU machine (your PC, RunPod, Vast.ai, a cloud VM) with ComfyUI, Wan2GP or Diffusers behind it, and add its address under Settings → GPU workers. The Model Router then picks the worker, backend and precision per shot.

fal.label: fal.ai (hosted, pay per use)
fal.how: Create a key at fal.ai/dashboard/keys and set FAL_KEY in apps/.env (or paste it in the Animations AI settings).

comfyui.label: Your GPU server (ComfyUI)
comfyui.how: Run ComfyUI on a GPU (RunPod / Vast.ai / your own), set COMFYUI_URL, and export each model's workflow to apps/comfyui_workflows/<model id>.json (see that folder's README).

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Workers AI (free tier)
cloudflare.how: Already used by the free image chain.

image.label: Image generation
image.auto: Qwen-Image when the picture must show readable text (posters, diagrams, labels, charts); Z-Image for everything else; FLUX.1 schnell when speed matters.

video.label: Video generation
video.auto: Wan 2.2 I2V for each shot; LTX-2.3 when the clip should follow the narration audio or run long; Wan VACE for continuity and repairs.

avatar.label: Character / avatar
avatar.auto: LongCat Avatar for a presenter speaking short scenes; InfiniteTalk for long lessons and dialogue; Wan 2.2 Animate when a whole body should copy a driving performance.

control.label: Control and finishing
control.auto: Used for specific jobs: re-styling a render while keeping its motion, re-shooting with a new camera.

reference.label: Pictures from references (Series)
reference.auto: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 draws every Series keyframe from the approved character sheets and the location picture, so faces, outfits and rooms stay the same from shot to shot.

speech.label: Voices (Series)
speech.auto: Indic Parler-TTS designs each character's voice from a description (you approve the sample); every line is then cloned from that sample: Chatterbox for its 23 languages (Hindi, English, …), IndicF5 for other Indian languages (Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, …). Edge voices (free, online) when no GPU voice is set up.

sound.label: Sound effects and music (Series)
sound.auto: HunyuanVideo-Foley watches each action clip and adds matching sound; ACE-Step 1.5 writes the background score (or use your own theme music).

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.best_for: Characters, scenes, props, concept art, backgrounds
models.why: 6B model, 8 steps, strong photoreal and illustration quality; ControlNet and LoRA variants exist.

models.name: Qwen-Image
models.best_for: Pictures with readable text: posters, diagrams, labels, educational graphics
models.why: Best open model at rendering text inside images (English and Chinese).

models.name: FLUX.1 schnell
models.why: Fastest good open model; also free through Cloudflare Workers AI.

models.name: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B
models.best_for: Animating each shot from its picture (general image-to-video)
models.why: Production backbone for open image-to-video: coherent motion, 480p-720p, 5 s clips.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 for the Wan 2.2 A14B/5B checkpoints; check any third-party fine-tune separately.

models.name: LTX-2.3 22B
models.best_for: Clips that follow the narration audio, and longer shots (up to ~20 s per call)
models.why: Audio-video model: audio-to-video and image-to-video, camera LoRAs, distilled 8-step variant.
models.license_note: Free for commercial use only for entities under $10M annual revenue, and not in a product that directly competes with Lightricks' own products (an AI video platform may count). Larger companies need a paid licence.

fal.price: $0.08 per second (1080p image-to-video); audio-to-video ~$0.0016 per megapixel of video

comfyui.template: Video → LTX-2.3 Image/Audio to Video (LTXVideo nodes)

models.name: Wan VACE 14B
models.best_for: Continuity between shots, repairs, re-styling a render while keeping its motion (depth/pose control)
models.why: One model for reference-guided generation, inpaint/outpaint, depth and pose control.

comfyui.template: Video → Wan VACE (reference / control to video)

models.name: LongCat Avatar 1.5
models.best_for: A presenter, teacher or narrator talking to camera, scene by scene
models.why: 8-step distilled audio-driven avatar, long videos through segments, single and multi-character.
models.license_note: Weights are MIT. fal.ai hosts LongCat Single Avatar; it doesn't say whether that is version 1.0 or 1.5 (your GPU server runs 1.5).

models.name: InfiniteTalk
models.best_for: Long lessons, interviews and dialogue (unlimited length, multi-speaker)
models.why: Built for unlimited-length audio-driven video on top of Wan 2.1 I2V 14B; keeps identity over long takes.

models.name: Wan 2.2 Animate 14B
models.best_for: Full-body performance: a character picture copies the motion of a driving video
models.why: Character animation and replacement from a driving video (move / replace modes).

models.name: SCAIL-2
models.best_for: Character animation and multi-character replacement from a driving video, no pose skeleton needed
models.why: End-to-end controlled character animation (512p/704p); a strong alternative to Wan Animate.
models.license_note: No hosted API yet: runs only on your GPU server.

models.name: Vista4D
models.best_for: Re-shooting a finished video from a new camera path (4D point clouds)
models.why: Re-shoot a scene from new angles; useful as a camera-movement reference.
models.license_note: No hosted API and no ComfyUI nodes yet: research code on your GPU server. Listed for reference; not wired into a button.
models.size: Wan 2.1 T2V 14B based, 80 GB class GPU

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
models.best_for: Series keyframes and character sheets: draws each shot from the approved character sheets and the location (up to 3 reference pictures)
models.why: The open model best at keeping several characters consistent across pictures (the 2511 release improved multi-person consistency); follows instructions like 'Raju and Amma argue in the kitchen, Raju on the left'.
models.size: 20B, ~41 GB bf16 (fp8 ~21 GB; Lightning LoRA: 4 steps)

models.name: Chatterbox Multilingual
models.best_for: Every line of dialogue in the character's approved voice, with an emotion level per line (23 languages incl. Hindi and English)
models.why: Zero-shot voice cloning from a short sample plus an 'exaggeration' control for anger, excitement or calm; MIT licence. Its audio carries Resemble's inaudible watermark.

models.name: IndicF5
models.best_for: Lines in Indian languages Chatterbox doesn't speak: Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese (and Hindi)
models.why: Trained on ~1,400 hours of Indian speech; clones the character's voice sample with its transcript.
models.license_note: Gated on Hugging Face: accept the terms on the model page and set HF_TOKEN on the GPU worker.

models.name: Indic Parler-TTS
models.best_for: Designing each character's voice from a description ('an old man, deep and slow, a little hoarse'), in 21 languages incl. English
models.why: Voices come from a text description, so every character gets a distinct voice without recordings; you approve the sample and the lines are cloned from it.
models.license_note: Gated on Hugging Face: accept the terms on the model page and set HF_TOKEN on the GPU worker.

models.name: HunyuanVideo-Foley
models.best_for: Sound effects that match each action clip: footsteps, doors, slaps, cooking, traffic, room tone (48 kHz)
models.why: Watches the clip and syncs the sound to what happens on screen, guided by a short description.
models.size: XL ~16 GB VRAM (8 GB with offload) · XXL ~20 GB (12 GB with offload)
models.license_note: Commercial use allowed; the licence doesn't cover the EU, UK or South Korea, and products with over 100M monthly users need Tencent's permission.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.best_for: Background score per part: a theme in the series' mood (instrumental or with lyrics, 50+ languages)
models.why: Fast open music model (a full song in seconds on an RTX 4090/5090), runs natively in ComfyUI.

fabric_about: fabric: what the Model Router needs. quality 0-1; vram_gb = VRAM to keep the model's diffusion transformer on the GPU per precision (Wan 2.2 A14B: one expert at a time; text encoders offloaded); min_vram_gb = smallest GPU it runs on with CPU offload (slow); speed = GPU seconds per output second (video) or per ~1 MP image on an RTX 4090 at fp8 with SageAttention (estimates: replaced by measured times after a few real runs); load_seconds = cold load; adapters = GPU worker backends that can run it; fal_usd / fal_usd_per_second = hosted price; hosted_seconds = typical hosted wait.
